'''Derrick Thackery''' is the host of ''[[The Tight End Zone]]'', a sports radio program on [[West Coast Talk Radio (3D Universe)|West Coast Talk Radio]] in ''[[Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas]]''.

He is voiced by [[Peter Appel]].

==History==
===Background===
Thackery has little to no interest in sports, preferring the passions surrounding sports.

He was molested as a youngster by his uncle and doesn't seem to like making definitive comments about sports, women or other things.
